description: 旅鸫是北美的一种鸟，见于林缘和开阔地。文献记录其取食矮丛蓝莓（Vaccinium angustifolium）的果实。

descriptions.en: The American robin is a North American bird found along forest edges and in open clearings. Its consumption of lowbush blueberry (Vaccinium angustifolium) fruit is documented.
descriptions.fr: Le Merle d’Amérique est un oiseau nord-américain présent en lisière de forêt et dans les clairières. Sa consommation de fruits du bleuet à feuilles étroites (Vaccinium angustifolium) est documentée.
descriptions.es: El zorzal robín es un ave norteamericana presente en los bordes de los bosques y en claros. Está documentado que consume frutos del arándano bajo (Vaccinium angustifolium).
descriptions.ja: コマツグミは北米の鳥で、林縁や開けた場所に生息する。ローブッシュブルーベリー（Vaccinium angustifolium）の果実を食べることが文献に記録されている。
descriptions.ko: 아메리카지빠귀는 북아메리카의 숲 가장자리와 탁 트인 곳에 사는 새다. 로우부시 블루베리(Vaccinium angustifolium)의 열매를 먹는다는 문헌 기록이 있다.

appearance.description: 成鸟通常具有灰色背部、深灰至黑色头部和红褐色腹部，尾下带白色。物种身份须结合完整识别资料核验。

formation: 见于北美林缘、林间空地，以及有树木和灌丛的开阔觅食地。其食物包括蚯蚓、昆虫和多种果实，取食组成随季节及当地条件变化。
storage: 本条目用于原地观察记录；保存日期、地点与识别依据。
applications: 记录本物种与矮丛蓝莓果实之间已有文献支持的取食关系。

acquisition.description: 在允许观察的地点，保持距离记录经可靠识别的旅鸫及可见行为。
conditions: 遵守所在地的进入、观察与野生动物保护规定。

sources.title: Tirmenstein, D. A. 1991. Vaccinium angustifolium, lowbush blueberry. USDA Forest Service, Fire Effects Information System. DOI: 10.2737/feis-species-review-vacang
sources.locator: Importance to Wildlife and Livestock → Fruit and flowers. Explicitly names American robin among birds consuming Vaccinium angustifolium fruit; the following Vaccinium spp. list is broader and is not substituted for this claim.

sources.title: Smithsonian’s National Zoo and Conservation Biology Institute. American robin (Turdus migratorius).
sources.locator: Physical Description; Native Habitat; Food/Eating Habits; Taxonomic Information; Help this Species. Supports identity, adult appearance, forest-edge and clearing habitat, mixed diet and observational context.

sources.title: Maryland Department of Natural Resources. Maryland’s Wild Acres: Creating a Wild Backyard — American Robin.
sources.locator: Natural History; How to Attract Robins. Supports open foraging ground near trees and shrubs, mixed diet and an explicit blueberry-food record. The generic blueberry wording supplements the species-specific FEIS record.

sources.title: National Institute of Biological Resources (Korea), Study on Korean names for major managed species and the national species list
sources.locator: Page 157 (catalog page 165), entry 68, Turdus migratorius. The review proposes 아메리카지빠귀 as the Korean name and documents earlier variants.
